title: Prenuvo
description: A clinic that is night above and day below: pure black and deep teal under white text, then white and a cool grey-blue fog under teal ink. Seafoam green for highlighted words and glowing dots, green-to-teal gradient pills, ocean blue and lilac as second accents. A round geometric display face over a humanist body; pills, 12px cards.
notes: light is the faithful mode: the night blocks (hero, MRI, panels, testimonial, membership cards, footer) carry the dark class themselves
chart-1/2/3 are the timeline dot colours (green, blue, lilac); chart-4 is the teal end of the CTA gradient; chart-5 is the crimson panel tone
Urbanist stands in for Gilroy (closest open geometric with a single-storey a); Lato is the original's own body face
name: prenuvo-theme
